summary: WorkerOptions.validateAndBuildWithDefaults() sets maxConcurrentPollers to a default value without checking if pollerAutoscalingBehaviour is already set, causing a mutual exclusivity validation error that prevents users from using the autoscaling feature.
userImpact: Users cannot use PollerBehaviorAutoscaling because the validation logic rejects valid configurations.
rootCause: validateAndBuildWithDefaults() sets maxConcurrentPollers default without first checking if pollerAutoscalingBehaviour is set.
proposedFix: Check if pollerAutoscalingBehaviour is set before applying default value for maxConcurrentPollers.
resolutionDetails: Modified validateAndBuildWithDefaults() to conditionally set maxConcurrentPollers default only when pollerAutoscalingBehaviour is not set.
keyQuote: workflowTaskPollersBehavior and maxConcurrentWorkflowTaskPollers are mutually exclusive
